default_body.markdown:
First Oxide Reborn release.

Oxide Reborn is an unofficial, independently maintained build of Zalith Launcher 2 (GPL-3.0).

Highlights:

- Rebranded product identity: **Oxide Reborn** (`dev.oxide.launcher`).
- Rebuilt GitHub Actions pipeline: unit tests, Android Lint, debug APK and per-ABI release APKs.
- All Kotlin/Java package roots, JNI symbols and ProGuard keep rules migrated in lockstep.
- Renderer plugin ecosystem compatibility preserved (both `oxideRendererPlugin` and the legacy `zalithRendererPlugin` keys).
- Update channel now served from this repository, with a CDN fallback.

Known limitations:

- See [COMPATIBILITY.md](https://github.com/HakaI963/oxide-reborn/blob/main/COMPATIBILITY.md) for identifiers that intentionally keep upstream naming.
- This build has been verified by compilation, unit tests and packaging only. It has not been validated on physical hardware by the project maintainers.
